name: 俯卧撑/引体向上极限测试（推算1RM）

map.俯卧撑/引体向上极限测试（推算1RM）是做什么的？: What does Push-up / Pull-up 1RM Estimator do?
map.如何使用俯卧撑/引体向上极限测试（推算1RM）？: How do I use Push-up / Pull-up 1RM Estimator?
map.俯卧撑/引体向上极限测试（推算1RM）适合哪些场景？: What scenarios is Push-up / Pull-up 1RM Estimator best for?
map.输入体重、动作类型与力竭次数，结合自重负荷比例，用 Epley 与 Brzyck: Enter body weight, movement type and reps-to-failure and combine bodyweight load ratios with the Epley and Brzycki formulas to estimate the movement 1RM and relative strength
map.由自重动作(俯卧撑/引体向上)的力竭次数 r 与体重负荷 w，用 Epley 与: From the reps-to-failure r of a bodyweight movement (push-up / pull-up) and the bodyweight load w, use the Epley and Brzycki formulas to estimate the one-rep max (1RM); relative strength = 1RM / body weight, and higher means greater upper-body/core strength.
map.俯卧撑姿势（影响自重负荷比例）: Push-up stance (affects the bodyweight load ratio)
map.上斜俯卧撑/脚垫高（约 70% 体重）: Incline push-up / elevated feet (~70% body weight)
map.自重训练用引体/俯卧撑最大次数估 1RM，跟踪上肢相对力量进展。: Use max pull-up/push-up reps to estimate 1RM in bodyweight training and track upper-body relative-strength progress.
map.做 15 个俯卧撑（末次力竭）→ 估 1RM≈体重×(1+15/30)；引体同理: Do 15 push-ups (last rep to failure) -> estimated 1RM ≈ body weight × (1 + 15/30); the same applies to pull-ups using the added load.
map.徒手怎么算？: How is it calculated for bodyweight only?
map.以自体重为负荷代入次数公式估算。: Use body weight as the load and plug it into the reps formula to estimate.
map.自重 1RM 和杠铃 1RM 能比吗？: Can bodyweight 1RM be compared with barbell 1RM?
map.自重版反映相对力量（÷体重），与杠铃绝对力量不可直接比，宜纵向跟踪。: The bodyweight version reflects relative strength (÷ body weight) and cannot be compared directly with barbell absolute strength; track it longitudinally.
map.俯卧撑按姿势取自重负荷比例（标准 64%、上斜 70%、跪姿 49%）折算为实际: For push-ups, use the bodyweight load ratio by stance (standard 64%, incline 70%, knee 49%) to convert to the actual weight pushed
map.引体向上负荷 = 体重 + 附加负重，全程力竭次数代入公式: Pull-up load = body weight + added load; plug the full-range reps-to-failure into the formula
map.Epley 公式：1RM = 负荷 × (1 + 次数/30)；Brzycki: Epley Formula: 1RM = load × (1 + reps/30); Brzycki Formula: 1RM = load × 36/(37 − reps)
map.次数超过 15 次时推算精度下降，结果仅供参考；1RM 测试有风险，务必有人保护: Estimation accuracy drops beyond 15 reps, so results are for reference only; 1RM testing carries risk, so always have a spotter
map.俯卧撑与引体向上极限测试 1RM 推算工具，结合自重负荷比例与 Epley、Br: A push-up and pull-up max-test 1RM estimator: combining bodyweight load ratios with the Epley and Brzycki formulas, it estimates the one-rep max load and relative-strength level. Processed entirely in the browser; data is not uploaded.
